data.name: Patrick
data.gender_notes: Patrick is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin patricius, 'nobleman, patrician'. Its root is Latin patricius. Saint Patrick, the apostle of Ireland. Patrick is a Latin name meaning “Nobleman; patrician”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Patrick expresses “Nobleman; patrician”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Patrick total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_english.name: Patrick
in_english.long_meaning: From the Latin patricius, 'nobleman, patrician'. Its root is Latin patricius. Saint Patrick, the apostle of Ireland. Patrick is a Latin name meaning “Nobleman; patrician”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.cultural_impact: Patrick is used in Latin naming tradition with the meaning “Nobleman; patrician”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Patrick is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Nobleman; patrician” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Patrick; such symbolism is interpretive.

historical_references.reference: Saint Patrick, the apostle of Ireland.

modern_usage.modern_context: No verified modern-usage statistics are published for Patrick.

name_in_real_life.note: No verified real-life bearer is published for this name.
